tasks.label: Composer Install (backend)
tasks.command: docker compose exec server-php-apache composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist --working-dir /var/www/html/backend

tasks.label: Symfony Cache Clear
tasks.command: docker compose exec server-php-apache php /var/www/html/backend/bin/console cache:clear
